column1: # Heart (Chalice), the Kolima secret boss. Also names rows 101 and 104.

column3: That face... Matthew?\nNo. You're not him. Who\nare you?{end_wait}
I'm Isaac. I don't know\nanyone named Matthew.\nWhy did you call me that?{end_wait}
A man with your face\ndefeated me once. I held\nback my full power.{end_wait}
Isaac, be careful. She\nspeaks as if that defeat\nstill weighs on her.{end_wait}
I came to observe this\nworld. But I won't hold\nback against you.{end_wait}
Then show us what you\ncan do. But afterward,\nyou will answer us.{end_wait}
You are not Matthew. I\nmistook you for him. But\nyou have your own strength.{end_wait}
Then tell us who Matthew\nis, and why you came\nhere.{end_wait}

I am Heart. I serve
Tuaparang. We escaped the
world that was lost.{page_break}We watch this world from
the shadows. Our purpose
is not yours to know.{end_wait}
You have earned this.\nTake it. We may meet\nagain, Isaac.{end_wait}
